items.heading: Problem Solving Is the Habit
items.text: Problem solving is the habit of defining a problem clearly, breaking it into parts, trying options and checking results. Critical thinking is the habit of asking what the evidence is, what is assumed and what else could explain it.

items.heading: Pick One Problem a Week
items.text: Pick one problem a week from your own life or work, such as a late bus, a messy sheet or a weak sales month. Write the problem in one sentence, list three possible causes, test one, and record what you learned.
